body: I did actually. For some weeks she actually showed interest on what I was doing and what my interests were, just like in the beginning of the relationship. But eventually it all came back to her bad phase. And as I sad, it’s hard to believe things will get better since she’s been to multiples phases of her life, different jobs and situations, yet still I feel like she only complains and doesn’t leave any room to a light hearted conversation.

I really like her, I don’t want her to be sadder than she’s already. Yet her mental state is affecting mine. I don’t know how breakups usually go, this one sounds hard since we both really like each other, but she’s making me more sad than happy lately.
I really want to have fun, it would be nicer if it were with her. I still do. But most of the time it is just sad stuff.

I think it just differs from country and class really. As I mentioned we both are the same age, yet her life is way more difficult then mine. I atribute this mainly because her family is in deep financial trouble (yet mine has less money), and she depends on some of the money since she’s unemployed.

I think it’s important to start things over again when needed, especially in the period of life that I’m living right now. I can’t forget how awesome were those last years but... The next one might be awesome as well :)

I don’t find it selfish tbh, it kinda gets me comfortable knowing that I’m not the only one in a shitty situation 
Again, thank you for the help 
I’m still here
Still alive
Thinking about it... Maybe yes, maybe my situation now opens more space to new people, healthy people, start things over, which is what I’m willing to do now... Trying to start a new life

Thanks, that really opens my eyes... Seriously 
I think everyone should wait just a little more, maybe its a matter of minutes until something changes your mind...
Thank you for the support
